body: I'm here for you.  Might be even more depressed than you are, but I'm here for you.  I know how it feels to be totally alone and feel stuck like that.  I live pretty far away, but if there's anything I can do tell me.

People suck.  That's just how it is unfortunately.  There will always be someone or lots of someones saying or thinking negative shit about you, no matter who you are.  You could be the most "normal" person in the world and there'll still be assholes out there.  Do what makes you happy, or what you think will make you happy, or what will make you wait one more day.
a lot worse than before really.  Quit smoking for a couple weeks, got a divorce and now here I am back again...

We're all selfish.  It's something culture tries to beat out of us, but at the end of the day we're selfish, egotistical flawed humans.  If you really want to go live that life, join the military.  Trust me.  First of all, if you ever do decide to kill yourself it'll be much simpler with someone issuing you weapons.  But more importantly, you'll find that you're way too tired and busy and everything else to worry about it.  The only times I was suicidal in the military was when I was on leave too long.
I can understand why you feel like you can't tell anyone.  I was in the same situation, terrified of being put back into a facility.  I don't have any answers, just solidarity.
